title: PlanResponse
description: An A-B-A-B run plan and what it can answer.

sigma.description: Pass-to-pass scatter of the primary channel per corner.

sigma_source.description: measured: from the baseline passes. assumed: no usable passes, a default was used.

corners.description: Corners the experiment is evaluated on.

passes_per_arm.description: Passes per arm in each corner if the plan is driven fully.

mde_detect.description: Smallest average effect per corner whose direction this plan establishes with 80 % power.

mde_decide.description: Smallest effect that also clears the equivalence band with 80 % power: what a decision needs.

sigma_lap.description: Scatter of whole laps: the error a lap shares across all its corners, in the primary channel's unit.

sigma_lap_source.description: planned: from push laps of earlier run plans on the baseline. free: from all its laps (fewer than six planned ones). none: too few laps to tell, assumed 0.

mde_target.description: The decision effect the plan was sized for, a whole number of equivalence bands: four, or the fewest that cover what four blocks decide on pass scatter alone.

target_met.description: false: even the longest plan allowed decides only mde_decide, more than mde_target.
